title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: which days are billed as demurrage days
content:
## Scope

Under the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category, this rule decides how many demurrage days a per-container record bills on its final demurrage line, and which calendar days that line covers.

## Rule

1. Under the separate clock model, the demurrage days are the days used by the demurrage clock beyond its free days.
2. Under the combined clock model, the n-th day of the merged clock falls on the start date plus n calendar days. On import the days up to and including the full gate-out date are demurrage days; on export the days after the full gate-in date are demurrage days. The demurrage days billed are the chargeable days of the merged clock that are demurrage days.
3. A record with no demurrage day beyond free time gets no demurrage line.
4. The first and last demurrage day billed are the first and last chargeable demurrage days themselves, so a demurrage line that ends at a terminal movement, such as the full gate-out date of an import record, ends on that movement's date and not on the clock-stop date.

## Restated as positions on the merged clock

The movement position is the number of calendar days from the clock start to the full gate-out date (import) or full gate-in date (export), less the product's clock start offset, increased by one.

- **Import**: demurrage days billed are the smaller of the days used and the gate-out position, less the merged free days; none when that does not exceed the free days.
- **Export**: demurrage days billed are the days used beyond the larger of the merged free days and the gate-in position; none when the days used do not go beyond it.

## Worked cases (hypothetical dates, an illustrative 15 merged free days, offset of one day)

| Record | Dates | Days used | Movement position | Demurrage days billed | Line covers |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Import | discharge 1 June, full gate-out 21 June, empty return 29 June | 28 | 20 | 5 (positions 16 to 20) | 17 June to 21 June |
| Import | discharge 1 June, full gate-out 12 June, empty return 29 June | 28 | 11 | none, no demurrage line | none |
| Export | empty pickup 1 June, full gate-in 10 June, loading 25 June | 24 | 9 | 9 (positions 16 to 24) | 17 June to 25 June |
| Export | empty pickup 1 June, full gate-in 20 June, loading 25 June | 24 | 19 | 5 (positions 20 to 24) | 21 June to 25 June |

In the first case the line ends on 21 June, the full gate-out date, even though the record's clock stopped on 29 June.
